metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the 'Movie List' title to the very top of slide 3. The evaluator checks that the title shape's top position is less than 100000 EMUs (approximately 0.1 inches from top). Original position was 274680 EMUs.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Shape matching uses substring matching (line 26: 'title_text in shape.text') which could match wrong shapes. If multiple shapes contain 'Movie List' as substring (e.g., 'Movie List Rankings'), the first match is used, not necessarily the actual title.
EDGE CASE: When multiple shapes contain the target text, only the first one found is checked. This could lead to false positives if a non-title shape is found first.
The evaluator correctly checks slide index 2 (Page 3), retrieves the PPTX file via postconfig save, and verifies position < 100000 EMUs
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification, ensuring the modified state is captured
Expected value of 100000 EMUs (~0.1 inches) is reasonable for 'very top' but could be more restrictive for stricter verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change line 26 from 'title_text in shape.text' to 'shape.text.strip() == title_text' for exact matching
Alternatively, prioritize checking the slide's title placeholder first before searching all shapes
